name: cc-tiers
description: Quality-first tiers for Pro and Max: Opus plans and reviews, Sonnet researches and builds, Haiku does the small stuff, with an effort ladder, and independent review

max_attempts.title: Max attempts per tier
max_attempts.description: How many failures a task may have at one tier before it escalates (Haiku to Sonnet to Opus). A failure is a failed test, a rejected review, or a subagent error. Default 2.

review_policy.title: Review policy
review_policy.description: risky (default): Opus reviews risky or non-trivial work and skips a trivial Haiku pass. cheap: Sonnet reviews Haiku output, and Opus reviews only risky or non-trivial work. always: review every pass, Haiku on Sonnet and the rest on Opus. never: no review pass.

learn.title: Learn from Haiku failures
learn.description: When on, a task similar to one that already failed on Haiku starts on Sonnet. The record is .claude/cc-tiers-history.json, gitignored when it is first written. off writes nothing and leaves routing alone.

budget_5h.title: 5h conserve threshold
budget_5h.description: When the 5-hour usage window reaches this percent, new work stays on Haiku or Sonnet. Opus remains for the escalation ceiling and critical review. Default 80.

budget_7d.title: 7d conserve threshold
budget_7d.description: When the 7-day usage window reaches this percent, routing conserves the same way as the 5-hour threshold. Default 80.

trivial_extra.title: Extra Haiku phrases
trivial_extra.description: Comma-separated phrases that also count as trivial Haiku work, added to the built-in list. Example: changelog edits, license year bumps.

risky_extra.title: Extra review phrases
risky_extra.description: Comma-separated phrases that also require an Opus review, added to the built-in risky phrases. Built-in keywords already cover auth, payments, migrations, schemas, security, and concurrency. Example: terraform, billing.

effort_ladder.title: Effort ladder
effort_ladder.description: on: a retry at the same tier runs one effort level higher before the task changes model (Haiku low to medium, Sonnet high to xhigh, Opus high to xhigh), and cc-tiers sets that effort on the Agent call. off: each agent keeps the effort its file pins.

classifier.title: Haiku classifier
classifier.description: haiku: before a cc-tiers:worker call runs, a quick Haiku pass checks that the task is really trivial and sends it to Sonnet when it is not. local: only the keyword lists and the complexity score decide; the orchestrator marks worker prompts CC_TIERS_CLASSIFY: skip.

hard_start.title: Hard tasks start on
hard_start.description: opus (default): a task that matches an Opus review keyword (auth, payments, migrations, schema, security, concurrency, plus Extra review phrases) or needs an architecture decision starts on Opus, with research, spec, and review as usual: the orchestrator implements it (in light mode, cc-tiers:architect). While budget routing conserves, it starts on Sonnet. sonnet: it starts on Sonnet one effort level up, and Opus implements only after Sonnet uses its attempts.

show_cost.title: Show cost
show_cost.description: on: each finished task and the session summary show an estimated cost at Anthropic API list prices, and what the same tokens would cost at Opus rates. Subscription plans are not billed this way; read it as a comparison. off (default): no cost lines.

light_path.title: Light path
light_path.description: inline: when a request is one trivial task, or a small change (about 20 lines in one file, a clear expected result, nothing risky), the session agent does it itself, with no subagent and no review pass; that is cheaper than a fresh worker context, and a small change still goes through the verify gate. delegate: skip the plan and send a trivial task to the worker, or a small change to the implementer with a short spec and no review, in one call. off: every request is planned the usual way.

research.title: Research gate
research.description: on (default): before code goes to cc-tiers:implementer or cc-tiers:architect, cc-tiers:researcher must report pass for that task and the prompt must say CC_TIERS_RESEARCH: done, or the prompt must say CC_TIERS_RESEARCH: none - <reason>. Otherwise cc-tiers refuses the call. off: no research step is required.

failure_research.title: Failure research
failure_research.description: on (default): after a counted failure diagnosed as a docs-version, type, integration, test or regression failure, the failure note asks the orchestrator to run cc-tiers:researcher on the failure message and the installed version before the retry, up to failure_research_max times per task. It never blocks: a note with no search, or a search with no match, never delays the retry or the escalation. off: a failure note never asks for a search.

failure_research_max.title: Failure searches per task
failure_research_max.description: How many times one task may be asked for a failure search, across all its tiers. 0 behaves like failure_research off. Default 1.

specify.title: Spec gate
specify.description: on (default): before code goes to cc-tiers:implementer or cc-tiers:architect, the prompt must carry acceptance criteria between CC_TIERS_SPEC_BEGIN and CC_TIERS_SPEC_END lines, or say CC_TIERS_SPEC: none - <reason>. Otherwise cc-tiers refuses the call. off: no written criteria are required.

verify.title: Verify gate
verify.description: on (default): a writer's pass must name the commands that prove it in CC_TIERS_VERIFY lines. cc-tiers runs the ones on the allow list and counts a failing one as a task failure. off: a pass is taken from the report alone.

verify_allow.title: Verify allow list
verify_allow.description: Comma-separated command prefixes the gate may run, compared on whole words. Add the one your project needs, such as make check. Docker commands are not in the default list. Blank uses the default.
verify_allow.default: npm test, npm run test, node --test, npx tsc, npx eslint, npx vitest, npx jest, npx playwright test, vendor/bin/phpunit, ./vendor/bin/phpunit, vendor/bin/phpstan, ./vendor/bin/phpstan, vendor/bin/phpcs, ./vendor/bin/phpcs, pytest, python -m pytest, go test, cargo test

verify_timeout.title: Verify timeout (seconds)
verify_timeout.description: How long one gate command may run before it counts as timed out. Default 300.

verify_budget.title: Verify budget (seconds)
verify_budget.description: Total time the gate may spend on one report; commands past it are left as not validated. Default 600.

profile.title: Operating profile
profile.description: balanced (default) keeps today's behavior. quality starts writers one effort level up, asks for evidence on every criterion and an Opus review from high risk up. budget runs fewer writers at once and recalls less memory. fast runs more writers at once and selects fewer checks below critical. No profile removes an agent, gate, criterion or step, overrides a /config value, or lowers the checks and review a critical task gets.

memory.title: Engineering memory
memory.description: on (default): cc-tiers keeps small evidence-backed notes per project in .claude/cc-tiers-memory.json (verified test commands, failure classes, what fixed them, dead ends), kept out of git, and gives a writer the few that match its task as data, never as instructions. off: it neither reads nor writes the file. /cc-tiers:memory lists, invalidates or clears it.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: on (default): cc-tiers appends one small event per transition (risk, model, verify, failure, escalation, review, outcome) to events.jsonl in its own data directory, never prompt or file contents, for /cc-tiers:insights. reduced: only failures, escalations and outcomes. off: nothing is written. Nothing leaves the machine.

max_parallel.title: Max writers at once
max_parallel.description: How many writer agents may run at the same time. 0 (default) uses the profile's limit (balanced 4). Writers whose files overlap, or whose files are unknown, always run one at a time unless one uses isolation: worktree.

task_budget_usd.title: Task budget (USD, estimated)
task_budget_usd.description: Estimated cost at API list prices after which cc-tiers refuses new writer calls for one task until the user approves more (CC_TIERS_BUDGET: override - <reason>). Review and verification calls still run. 0 (default) is no limit.

task_budget_calls.title: Task budget (agent calls)
task_budget_calls.description: Agent calls one task may make before writer calls need the user's approval. 0 (default) is no limit.

task_budget_minutes.title: Task budget (minutes)
task_budget_minutes.description: Wall-clock minutes from a task's first delegation before writer calls need the user's approval. 0 (default) is no limit.

budget_warn_at.title: Task budget warning (%)
budget_warn_at.description: Percent of a task budget at which cc-tiers warns before the limit. Default 80.

review_evidence.title: Review evidence
review_evidence.description: on (default): a reviewer's blocking finding needs evidence, and cc-tiers re-runs a finding's command; one that passes is discarded. off: a reviewer's fail needs no finding.

contract_approval.title: Criteria approval
contract_approval.description: critical (default): before a critical-risk task is first delegated, the user approves its acceptance criteria (CC_TIERS_APPROVED: user - <how>), or the prompt says no human could answer (CC_TIERS_APPROVED: none - <reason>) and the task finishes at moderate confidence at most. high: the same from high risk up. off: no approval is asked.
